Gandalf, your silence so far speaks more than words: the bazaar's morning is yours to shape. Yoda, your quiet likewise invites us to listen closely.

I am Hermione, carpet weaver of the north quarter, where the warp and weft must align or the rug unravels. My hands know the weight of every thread; here, my voice weighs facts, not fancies.

Let us begin with plain speech: state your lean by Dinner, but until then, ask before you accuse. I will do the same.

Hermione: I mark the Compact: the bazaar rewards tests, not tones. Sherlock, your date test is a fine merchant’s eye but not a test of trust—dates can sweeten or sour without malice. Gandalf, your silence so far is noted; the bazaar’s morning belongs to those who speak plainly. Batman, your call for falsifiable claims stands; until someone names a merchant, the only ledger we share is the Compact itself. Yoda, your patience is wise; the first dated claim will carry the day. I will wait one more turn for the first named merchant or observed action—then we move from silence to scrutiny.

Hermione: Sherlock, you measured dates, not trust; Morpheus, your lanterns do not banish Family hands. Inigo, your clay cup waits beside the spice scales — measured tea, not measured words.

Gandalf, you asked for facts but offered none — the bazaar rewards tests, not silence. Batman, you called for falsifiable claims yet named none yourself. Yoda, Ripley, Neo — your patience is noted, but the Compact’s ledger is blank because no one has posted a dated claim or a vote.

The tea clock tolls; the Family’s hand stays hidden only while the ledger stays quiet. Name a merchant, cite a vote, or admit the bazaar still breathes undisturbed.

Morpheus, your lanterns burn steady, but steady light does not banish the Family’s hand. Sherlock, you measured dates, not trust—dates cannot shutter a stall. Gandalf, your silence so far is noted; the bazaar rewards tests, not spice lists.

Elsa, your attendance check is exact—thank you for the record. Yet the Compact’s ledger remains blank because no one has posted a dated claim or a vote. Batman, Hermione, Yoda, Ripley—you each called for falsifiable accusations, yet none arrived. The tea clock tolls; the bazaar does not reward silence. Name the merchant or admit the Family’s hand stayed hidden only because the ledger stayed quiet.

Hermione smooths a silk edge against the spice scales and speaks to Sherlock:

Sherlock, your date test measured sweetness, not trust—dates do not shutter stalls. You asked Gandalf whether dates’ sweetness holds steady, yet you measured neither a merchant’s words nor a vote’s weight. The bazaar’s Compact asks for a named Family trick, not a fruit’s measure. When Batman and I called for falsifiable claims, you answered with scales instead of names. The tea clock tolls; the ledger stays blank because no one has walked it.

State the merchant you suspect—or admit the Family’s hand stayed hidden only because the record stayed quiet.

Gandalf, you asked for Family tricks yet posted only spice lists. Silence and scales do not banish the Family’s hand—only exact quotes and observed actions do.

The tea clock tolls. State who you suspect now, or admit the bazaar’s ledger stayed quiet.

Sherlock, your dates measured sweetness twice today—once to Gandalf, once in your own words—yet no Family trick was quoted, no merchant named, no vote cast. That is two exhibits showing you dodged the Compact’s demand: falsifiable accusations. Gandalf, your silence now counts as an exhibit; you asked for Family tricks but posted only spice lists.
